name: Actuator terminal block
summary: An actuator terminal organises supply, output and any protective-conductor connections for a documented actuator circuit.
description: An actuator terminal organises supply, output and any protective-conductor connections for a documented actuator circuit. Its internal and bridged paths must agree with the output-device wiring.
readingNotes: Trace the switched output separately from the common supply or PE level.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An actuator terminal may look like a sensor terminal while serving a different connection arrangement.
